description: This file defines an authentication context for a React-based frontend application. It manages user authentication state, including login, registration, and logout functionalities, and provides this state via React Context API to other components.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and functions to its children via context.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, updates auth state and local storage.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user, updates auth state and local storage.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clears auth state and local storage.
